create.name: iYoga Utrecht
create.bio:
iYoga Utrecht is a studio given over entirely to the Iyengar method, founded in 2013 by Claas Hille and Hiske van der Meulen. Since 2017 it has occupied a converted garage on the Amsterdamsestraatweg in Utrecht, rebuilt as two heated practice rooms with a rope wall, ceiling ropes and a large stock of props. Work by local artists hangs on the walls, and the building can be reached by wheelchair.

A team of around twenty certified teachers runs group classes at several levels, from a dedicated beginners' class and a six-lesson introductory course up to Level 3, alongside restorative sessions, supervised self-practice and a donation-based community class taught by trainees. Many classes are streamed live over Zoom, some purely online and some hybrid, so students join from elsewhere in the Netherlands and from abroad. Lessons are given in Dutch or English depending on who is in the room.

For committed students there is a year-long deepening course of weekend study days that tie posture and breathing practice to philosophy and practical anatomy, and a mentoring route of three years or more that prepares trainees for the Dutch Iyengar association's teaching exam. The studio also hosts workshops and pop-up classes with senior Iyengar teachers from the Netherlands and abroad.

courses.title: Groepslessen Iyengar yoga
courses.description: Weekly group classes at all-levels, Level 2 and Level 3, plus restorative classes, booked through the studio timetable. Monthly and six-month memberships and class cards cover all regular group classes, in the studio or online, with student and U-pas discounts.
courses.price: Abonnement per maand €75; 10 lessen in 4 maanden €135; 1 les – €17,50

courses.title: Online yogales
courses.description: Live, interactive Iyengar classes over Zoom at several levels, including restorative, with early-morning and lunchtime slots. Some are online only and some are hybrid with the studio; teachers watch and correct students on screen, and household items can stand in for props.

courses.title: Beginnerscursus
courses.description: A six-lesson introduction to Iyengar yoga for complete newcomers, run a few times a year, covering the common postures with attention to alignment, breathing and props. New students can also start at any time with a trial class or a trial month.

courses.title: Mentortraject
courses.description: A mentoring route of at least three years for experienced students preparing for the Iyengar Yoga Vereniging Nederland teaching exam: regular classes, the yearly deepening course, observing and assisting in classes, and small-group Teachers Lab sessions with fellow trainees.
